title: rubus macrophyllus var. lasiaxon
intro: Rubus macrophyllus var. lasiaxon, commonly known as the Korean raspberry or Korean bramble, is a type of plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae) native to East Asia. It is valued for its various health benefits, including its potential to lower cholesterol and blood sugar levels, as well as its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve gastrointestinal issues, and exhibit antiviral and antibacterial activities. The bioactive constituents of Rubus macrophyllus var. lasiaxon include tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
